q: The length of a pendulum is made four times as long. By what factor does its period change when the swings are small?
a: $T = 2\pi\sqrt{\tfrac{l}{g}}$, so the period is proportional to the square root of the length. The factor is $\sqrt{4} = 2$: the period doubles.
